details.description:
ROYAL CANIN® Veterinary Health Nutrition Since 1968, Royal Canin has been following the belief that nutrition plays a key role in supporting the health and wellbeing of cats and dogs. This is why we have designed ROYAL CANIN® veterinary diets around proven nutritional science in partnership with pet professionals and experts, delivering nutrition for pets with specific health needs. 

ROYAL CANIN® Skin Care is specially formulated to support skin and coat health in adult dogs. ROYAL CANIN® Skin Care Dog Food is expertly formulated in partnership with nutrition specialists. 


ROYAL CANIN® Skin Care is a dry dog food for sensitive skin, suitable for:
•	Dogs with atopic dermatitis
•	Skin and coat support for other cases of dermatitis, such as flea allergic dermatitis or pyodermatitis. 

Key Benefits:
•	Dermal care 
o	Thanks to the inclusion of a combination of essential fatty acids, this diet helps to nutritionally support dogs with sensitive skin. 
•	Skin barrier 
o	This formula contains nutrients that help to support the natural protective barrier role of your dog's skin. 
•	Digestive tolerance 
o	Contains nutrients which support a balanced intestinal flora and digestive transit. 

As part of the ROYAL CANIN® Veterinary Range, it is important that this product is only fed to your pet when recommended by a veterinary professional. Transitioning your pet from one diet to another should be a smooth and gradual process over a 7-10-day period. Please ensure you follow the correct rationing amount.

Please note: Royal Canin Skin Care is not suitable for growth, pregnancy or lactation.

nutritionalInfo.description: ROYAL CANIN® SKIN CARE dry is a complete dietetic feed for dogs formulated for the support of skin function in the case of dermatosis and excessive loss of hair. High level of linoleic acid (LA) and of sum of eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA). RECOMMENDATIONS: It is recommended that a veterinarian’s opinion be sought before use. Feed SKIN CARE dry initially up to 2 months.
